_comment: Per-test kept-red expectation manifest for the #1952 async-onError result-dropped proof (counter-fix of PR #2047). Read by apps/front/scripts/ci/run-preuves.mts. The declared test MUST fail with an AssertionError on correct code; the runner refuses to classify if this file is missing or malformed.

expectedRed.testName: RED: the async-onError resolved value is dropped from the wrapped result (issue #1952)
expectedRed.why: On correct code tryCatchWrapper forwards the async onError's resolved value ('async-on-error-ok') as the wrapped result, so `expect(result).not.toBe('async-on-error-ok')` fails with an AssertionError. If this test PASSES, the async-onError branch is again dropping (or replacing) onError's resolved value — the #1952 payload-collapse defect class is back — and the proof has flipped green, which run-preuves reports as a stale/corrupt proof.
